1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA for the State-respondent and perused the record.

2. The instant bail application under Section 439 Cr.P.C. has been filed with a prayer to enlarge the applicant on bail in Case Crime No. 458 of 2022, under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471 IPC, Police Station Kotwali Nagar, District Banda, during the pendency of trial.

entities.text: Police Station Kotwali Nagar, District Banda
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 3. Counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant has been falsely implicated in the instant case.
The applicant was a marginal witness of the sale-deed dated 17.07.2022.
No amount has been credited in the account of the applicant.
The applicant is not a beneficiary of any illicit transaction.
The criminal history of the applicant has been explained in para 15 of the affidavit.

1 in jail since 27.03.2023 and in case he is enlarged on bail, he will not misuse the said liberty.
4.

sentences.text: Learned AGA has opposed the prayer for bail but could not satisfactorily dispute the aforesaid submissions from the record.
5. Having regard to the submissions made but without commenting on merits of the case, I am of the opinion that the applicant is entitled to be enlarged on bail.
In case of breach of any of the above conditions, the prosecution shall be at liberty to move bail cancellation application before this Court.
